title: Rumen Bypass Choline

sections.heading: Choline
sections.text: The transition period in dairy cattle is marked by intense metabolic stress, often resulting in fatty liver syndrome, ketosis, and reproductive inefficiencies. Inadequate choline availability exacerbates these challenges by impairing fat mobilization and liver function. Rumen Bypass Choline Silver Pearls utilizes a state-of-the-art ANBioT™ encapsulation process to deliver choline chloride in rumen bypass form. This ensures that choline is released in the small intestine, where it effectively supports fat metabolism, liver function, and milk synthesis. Components Physical Appearance: Free-flowing silver-grey pearls Content (% w/w): NLT 28-30% Choline Chloride Moisture (% w/w): NMT 8%

Target Release: Designed to maximize bioavailability and efficacy.

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.text: Microencapsulation Technology: Advanced microencapsulation protects choline integrity throughout the rumen. Target Release: Designed to maximize bioavailability and efficacy. Benefits Helps in a smooth transition period and prevents post-partum metabolic disorders like Ketosis and fatty liver syndrome. Facilitates phospholipid synthesis and lipid transport to mammary glands to support milk fat synthesis. Helps in maintaining tissue integrity, cell membrane structure, and stability.
